file.description: Search one explicitly allowed file. Mutually exclusive with files; omit both to search all allowed files.

offset.description: Legacy single-file forward byte offset. Prefer nextCursor for continuation with snapshot checks. A nonzero offset cannot be combined with tail, cursor or a line range.

startLine.description: First physical line to search, numbered from 1 and inclusive. A range requires one selected file. Defaults to 1 when only endLine is supplied. Cannot be combined with tail or a nonzero byte offset.

endLine.description: Last physical line to search, inclusive and not before startLine. Omit to search onward from startLine. maxLines still limits the matching records returned per page.

tail.description: Read backwards to collect the last maxLines matching records. Continue towards older records with nextCursor. This is a snapshot, not a live subscription.

maxLines.description: Maximum matching physical lines in this page, further bounded by policy and response size.

from.description: Inclusive event timestamp, not file modification time: ISO-8601 with offset (2026-10-28T10:00:00+01:00), -15m, -1h, or now-2d. If supplied without to, to is now.

to.description: Exclusive event timestamp in ISO-8601 or relative form. With only to, from is the maximum allowed range before to. Omit both to disable time filtering. Lines with missing/invalid timestamps are counted and excluded when filtering by time.

levels.description: Optional levels, for example ["ERROR","WARN"]. Common aliases are normalized. Records with no recognized level do not match an explicit level filter.

scanBytes.description: Maximum source bytes scanned in one call, independent of the smaller response size. A capped scan returns scanComplete=false and nextCursor; continue even if this page has no matches.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the preceding response. Repeat the same connection, file(s), line range, filters, tail and limits. Relative time bounds stay anchored to the first call. Rotation, truncation or detected changes to the scanned snapshot invalidate the cursor; appends beyond the snapshot do not extend it.

files.description: Exact allowed root-relative file names in scan order. No wildcards or unselected files. Omit file and files for the configured allowlist order.

query.description: Text or RE2 regular expression to match against the masked complete line. Empty or omitted matches all records meeting the other filters.

matchMode.description: Literal substring or RE2 regex. Regex supports alternation, groups, character classes and anchors; backreferences and look-around are not supported.

caseSensitive.description: Whether text and regular-expression matching is case-sensitive.
